places.name: Spettle farm
places.note: Call hires the two oldest boys of a poor widow's barefoot family; they set off on foot for Lonesome Dove.
places.location_hint: small poor creek-bottom farm a short way north of Pickles Gap, in the brush country; within a day's ride of Lonesome Dove and of the Rainey ranch

places.name: Rainey ranch
places.note: Call eats a huge supper, sleeps in a wagon in the yard, and gets two Rainey sons promised for the drive.
places.location_hint: south Texas brush country, reached by sundown after the Spettle farm north of Pickles Gap; more than fifteen miles from Lonesome Dove, roughly northeast of it

places.name: Pickles Gap
places.note: The Spettle farm lies a little north of it.
places.location_hint: small settlement in the south Texas brush near Lonesome Dove

places.name: Brush Country
places.note: Riding home, Call skirts its southern edge and finds the horse herd's tracks heading back south.
places.location_hint: south Texas scrub north and northeast of Lonesome Dove

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call returns to find Augustus napping on the porch; Augustus reports that Pedro Flores has reportedly died, which leaves Call unexpectedly hollow.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; Call cut west about fifteen miles out on his return

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: The horse herd grazes a little way upriver from town under guard.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Pedro Flores long dominated about a hundred miles of border; Augustus jokes they could take over northern Mexico now.

places.name: Eastern United States
places.note: The widow Spettle is said to have grown up wealthy there with servants.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: The Spettle boys once helped drive a small herd there.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call tells the Raineys Jake praises it; after hearing of Pedro's death Call says they might as well go.

places.raw_name: the Clear Fork of the Brazos
places.name: Clear Fork Brazos River
places.note: Where a young soldier killed the Comanche raider Kicking Wolf about ten years ago.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Kicking Wolf once raided it with a handful of braves and carried off three women.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: Augustus says he might drown in it like the Pumphrey boy did.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: Augustus on the Hat Creek porch; Call riding off in town to find and hire Jasper Fant

groups.label: Horse guard
groups.hint: holding the horse herd a little upriver from Lonesome Dove

groups.label: Spettle brothers
groups.hint: walking from their farm north of Pickles Gap toward Lonesome Dove

groups.label: Rainey family
groups.hint: Jimmy and Ben promised to reach Lonesome Dove by week's end
